name: Unidentified green flying species
description: This species was a sentient species distinguished by their green skin and ray-like frames, lacking arms or legs, instead possessing a pair of wing-like limbs. Capable of flight, they seemingly had few facial features, save for a mouth on the underside of their bodies and potentially squinted eyes. They donned only strapped satchels for clothing. In 4 ABY, at least two members of this species were present in a casino on the planet Qiaxx.
